section.catchline: Definitions -- Municipality filing requirements for lodging unit capacity -- Failure to meet eligibility requirements -- Notice to municipality -- Municipality authority to impose tax.
section.subsection: As used in this section:"High-occupancy lodging unit" means each bedroom in a:hostel; ora unit similar to a hostel as determined by the commission by rule."High-occupancy lodging unit capacity of a municipality" means the product of:the total number of high-occupancy lodging units within the incorporated boundaries of a municipality on the first day of the calendar quarter during which the municipality files the form described in Subsection (3); andfour."Recreational lodging unit" means each site in a:campground that:is issued a business license by the municipality in which the campground is located; andprovides the following hookups:water;sewer; andelectricity;recreational vehicle park that provides the following hookups:water;sewer; andelectricity; orunit similar to Subsection (1)(c)(i) or (ii) as determined by the commission by rule."Recreational lodging unit capacity of a municipality" means the product of:the total number of recreational lodging units within the incorporated boundaries of a municipality on the first day of the calendar quarter during which the municipality files the form described in Subsection (3); andfour."Special lodging unit" means a lodging unit:that is a:high-occupancy lodging unit;recreational lodging unit; orstandard lodging unit;for which the commission finds that in determining the capacity of the lodging unit the lodging unit should be multiplied by a number other than a number described in:for a high-occupancy lodging unit, Subsection (1)(b)(ii);for a recreational lodging unit, Subsection (1)(d)(ii); orfor a standard lodging unit, Subsection (1)(i)(ii); andfor which the municipality in which the lodging unit is located files a written request with the commission for the finding described in Subsection (1)(e)(ii)."Special lodging unit capacity of a municipality" means the sum of the special lodging unit numbers for all of the special lodging units within the incorporated boundaries of a municipality on the first day of the calendar quarter during which the municipality files the form described in Subsection (3)."Special lodging unit number" means the number by which the commission finds that a special lodging unit should be multiplied in determining the capacity of the special lodging unit."Standard lodging unit" means each bedroom in:a hotel;a motel;a bed and breakfast establishment;an inn;a condominium that is:part of a rental pool; orregularly rented out for a time period of less than 30 consecutive days;a property used as a residence that is:part of a rental pool; orregularly rented out for a time period of less than 30 consecutive days; ora unit similar to Subsections (1)(h)(i) through (vi) as determined by the commission by rule."Standard lodging unit capacity of a municipality" means the product of:the total number of standard lodging units within the incorporated boundaries of a municipality on the first day of the calendar quarter during which the municipality files the form described in Subsection (3); andthree."Transient room capacity" means the sum of:the high-occupancy lodging unit capacity of a municipality;the recreational lodging unit capacity of a municipality;the special lodging unit capacity of a municipality; andthe standard lodging unit capacity of a municipality.

A municipality that imposes a tax under this part shall provide the commission the following information as provided in this section:the high-occupancy lodging unit capacity of the municipality;the recreational lodging unit capacity of the municipality;the special lodging unit capacity of the municipality; andthe standard lodging unit capacity of the municipality.

A municipality shall file with the commission the information required by Subsection (2):on a form provided by the commission; andon or before:for a municipality that is required by Section 59-12-403 to provide notice to the commission, the day on which the municipality provides the notice required by Section 59-12-403 to the commission; orfor a municipality that is not required by Section 59-12-403 to provide notice to the commission, July 1 of each year.

If the commission determines that a municipality that files the form described in Subsection (3) has a transient room capacity that is less than 66% of the municipality's permanent population, the commission shall notify the municipality in writing:that the municipality's transient room capacity is less than 66% of the municipality's permanent population; andfor a municipality that is required by Section 59-12-403 to provide notice to the commission, within 30 days after the day on which the municipality provides the notice to the commission; orfor a municipality that is not required by Section 59-12-403 to provide notice to the commission, on or before September 1.

subsection.subsection: For a municipality that does not impose a tax under Section 59-12-401 on the day on which the municipality files the form described in Subsection (3), if the commission provides written notice described in Subsection (4) to the municipality, the municipality may not impose a tax under this part until the municipality meets the requirements of this part to enact the tax.

For a municipality that is not required by Section 59-12-403 to provide notice to the commission, if the commission provides written notice described in Subsection (4) to the municipality for three consecutive calendar years, the municipality may not impose a tax under this part:beginning on July 1 of the year after the year during which the commission provided written notice described in Subsection (4):to the municipality; andfor the third consecutive calendar year; anduntil the municipality meets the requirements of this part to enact the tax.

section.subsection: The requirements of this section do not apply to a municipality that:is a creating entity of a major sporting event venue zone; andonly imposes a tax authorized under this part on transactions that occur within the sales and use tax boundary of a major sporting event venue zone.

For purposes of this section, population for each municipality shall be based on, to the extent not otherwise required by federal law:the most recent estimate from the Utah Population Committee created in Section 63C-20-103; orif the Utah Population Committee estimate is not available for each municipality and unincorporated area, the adjusted sub-county population estimate provided by the Utah Population Committee in accordance with Section 63C-20-104.
